changeSet.author: grushton
changeSet.comment: This changeset will be timed to 14 days post-RAS migration. This action will clear out NIH status fields for all users whose 30-day authentications were prior 14 days ago. Users who've signed in before that will be required to re-authenticate with NIH when they next sign in.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE users SET era_commons_id = NULL WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_property WHERE property_key = 'eraExpiration' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(property_value as BIGINT) / 1000) - INTERVAL '14 days' < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); DELETE FROM user_property WHERE property_key IN ('eraAuthorized', 'eraExpiration') AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_property WHERE property_key = 'eraExpiration' AND TO_TIMESTAMP(CAST(property_value as BIGINT) / 1000) - INTERVAL '14 days' < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
